betterSidebar.addPluginsBrowseMore: Browse more plugins on GitHub (topic: dsh-better-sidebar)
betterSidebar.addPluginsEmpty: No plugins curated yet — publish yours under the GitHub topic
betterSidebar.addPluginsSearch: Search by plugin name or description…
betterSidebar.addPluginsTabDesc: Sidebar pages (tabs) can be extended by plugins. Plugins register through the ctx.betterSidebar service; clicking Install copies the install command — paste it into a terminal where your DSH profile lives and run it.
betterSidebar.addPluginsViewerDesc: File previewers can be extended by plugins. Plugins register through the ctx.betterSidebar service; clicking Install copies the install command — paste it into a terminal where your DSH profile lives and run it.
betterSidebar.binaryNoPreview: This file type cannot be previewed
betterSidebar.browserBlockedLoopback: Blocked: local and internal addresses cannot be browsed here
betterSidebar.browserBlockedScheme: Blocked: only http/https URLs are allowed
betterSidebar.browserEmbedBlockedDesc: The site forbids being displayed inside other pages (X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors), so it cannot load in the sidebar. Open it directly in your browser instead.
betterSidebar.browserNoSandboxWarning: Sandbox off: the current page runs with full GUI privileges (re-enable in settings)
betterSidebar.browserStart: Enter a URL to start browsing (sandbox mode)
betterSidebar.cherryPickDesc: Apply the changes of "{subject}" to the current branch.
betterSidebar.discardDesc: This discards the worktree changes of "{path}" (not recoverable).
betterSidebar.editorEmptyHint: Pick a file from the tree panel or the path input above to start previewing
betterSidebar.editorExplorerMergedDesc: Files switch in place in the same window; new windows start with the tree open
betterSidebar.editorExplorerSplitDesc: Path-less windows are the standalone explorer (tree only); each file opens its own window (tree docked, closed by default)
betterSidebar.editorPathPlaceholder: File path (relative to the session directory or absolute), Enter to open
betterSidebar.editorSearchTruncated: Too many results — showing a partial list
betterSidebar.htmlNoSandboxWarning: Sandbox off: this HTML runs with full GUI privileges (re-enable in settings)
betterSidebar.jobNotReadYet: Waiting for the model to read this job; its output appears here once the model runs job_output
betterSidebar.mermaidZoomHint: Scroll to zoom · drag to pan · Esc to close
betterSidebar.noSession: Select a conversation to use the sidebar
betterSidebar.notRepo: This directory is not a git repository
betterSidebar.openWithSettingsCustomDesc: Name + URL template ({path} placeholder) + VSCode-family flag; in remote mode only VSCode-family editors can open a remote path
betterSidebar.openWithSettingsFamilyDesc: This editor speaks the VSCode URL dialect (supports SSH-remote opens)
betterSidebar.openWithSettingsInvalidHint: Editors with a missing name or a template without {path} / scheme:// are not shown in the menu
betterSidebar.openWithSettingsSshDesc: Empty = local workspace; with a user@host or SSH alias, VSCode-family openers switch to the vscode-remote/ssh-remote protocol and the File Manager / Zed / non-VSCode-family custom editors are hidden from the menu
betterSidebar.pluginDocsPanelDesc: Global docs in the DSH sidebar: read your own Markdown notes from any workspace — a file list, an outline, open in Chrome / VS Code, and copy buttons; the docs directory is configurable (default ~/.dsh/docs)
betterSidebar.pluginFlowglassDesc: Live session flowgraph with three lanes for user, assistant, and tool calls, plus parallel groups, sub-agent branches, drill-down, and live status; registers a native Flowglass tab when better-sidebar is installed and keeps its standalone drawer as a fallback
betterSidebar.pluginGitForgeDesc: Git Forge tab: GitHub/Gitea (and other forge) account library + per-project grants + hard push policy; tokens stay in local secrets (never in model context); read-only GitForge tool and agent HTTPS credential helper
betterSidebar.pluginGitRemotesDesc: Git Remotes tab: branch/upstream/ahead-behind, fetch (optional prune), ff-only pull, and push only after an in-tab confirm. Does not replace the built-in Git stage/commit tab, and does not offer force-push or a model auto-push tool
betterSidebar.pluginOfficeDesc: Office-suite preview (.docx / .xlsx / .pptx) for the better-sidebar editor, keeping the heavy Office render libraries out of the core bundle
betterSidebar.pluginSentinelDesc: Condition-driven agent wakeup: file/process/port/http/command/webhook sensors wake dormant sessions when conditions fire; registers a "Sentinel" tab with the server-wide watch table
betterSidebar.pluginSidebarQaDesc: Select-and-ask: Select conversation text → ask in the right-side panel → a dedicated follow-up session (❓追问) in the same workspace; a fast no-thinking model compresses the main context and injects it with the quote, without interrupting the main conversation. Follow-ups nest, continue, and archive
betterSidebar.pluginSshTunnelDesc: SSH Tunnel tab: multi-host inventory + per-project grants + local secrets; SSHManager tool (exec/SFTP/session strategies); center interactive terminal and dual-pane SFTP
betterSidebar.pluginTurnReviewDesc: A human gate on the just-finished turn: Approve / Request changes per path with an optional comment; paths grouped by main session / subagent / unattributed; inline snapshot-vs-now diff before you decide. No fork, no /rewind
betterSidebar.pluginVideoPreviewDesc: Inline video preview (.mp4/.webm/.mov/.mkv/.avi etc.) for the better-sidebar editor, backed by a dedicated /video host route with HTTP Range (206) support — scrubbing works and files are not capped by the 20MB mediaLimit
betterSidebar.revertDesc: Create a new commit on the current branch that reverts "{subject}".
betterSidebar.sandboxStatusOn: Sandbox mode: on · pages cannot access the GUI's data or local files; logins and third-party cookies may not work
betterSidebar.settingsBottomTerminalDesc: When the bottom panel is expanded for the first time in a session, try to open a fresh terminal tab there (the terminal quota still applies; on by default)
betterSidebar.settingsBottomTerminalTitle: Auto-open a terminal on the bottom panel's first expansion
betterSidebar.settingsBrowserHttpDesc: When on, clicking an HTTP external link in the chat or GUI opens the sidebar (plugin pages declaring urlTarget win); Ctrl/Cmd+click always bypasses
betterSidebar.settingsBrowserHttpTitle: Open HTTP pages in the sidebar
betterSidebar.settingsBrowserHttpsDesc: When on, clicking an HTTPS external link in the chat or GUI opens the sidebar. Off by default: most HTTPS sites refuse to be embedded, so the system browser is the smoother default
betterSidebar.settingsBrowserHttpsTitle: Open HTTPS pages in the sidebar
betterSidebar.settingsBrowserLinksDesc: When on, clicking an external link in the chat or GUI opens the sidebar instead of a new window; HTTP and HTTPS are controlled separately by the switches below; Ctrl/Cmd+click always bypasses
betterSidebar.settingsBrowserLinksTitle: Open chat external links in the sidebar
betterSidebar.settingsBrowserSandboxDesc: With the sandbox off, any visited site runs with the same origin as the GUI: it can read session data and act as your logged-in session. Only enable for fully trusted sites
betterSidebar.settingsConflict: The setting changed in another window — please retry
betterSidebar.settingsCustomCssDesc: Styles appended at the end of the page (later in the cascade wins ties; use !important to override JS-written inline variables)
betterSidebar.settingsFontFamilyDesc: Custom terminal font family (a CSS font-family stack like "JetBrains Mono", monospace; leave empty to follow the theme's monospace font)
betterSidebar.settingsFontSizeDesc: Terminal font size in px (9–32, default 13)
betterSidebar.settingsHtmlDefaultUnsafeDesc: When on, every newly opened HTML preview starts in the unsandboxed state (same origin as the GUI — it can read session files and internal APIs); the status row still offers a one-tap restore
betterSidebar.settingsHtmlDefaultUnsafeTitle: Open HTML previews unsandboxed by default (unsafe)
betterSidebar.settingsHtmlSandboxDesc: With the sandbox off, previewed HTML runs with the same origin as the GUI: it can read session files, local storage and call internal APIs. Only enable for fully trusted files
betterSidebar.settingsIntro: Manage what the side card shows and how it behaves
betterSidebar.settingsJobsDesc: Expand the side card and open the Jobs page whenever a new background job appears for the current conversation (every new job triggers); turn off to open it manually
betterSidebar.settingsJobsTitle: Auto-open the Jobs page on a new background job
betterSidebar.settingsOpenDesc: Expand the side card automatically for brand-new conversations; existing conversations keep their own layouts
betterSidebar.settingsOpenPathDesc: Open file links in the chat (tool rows, produced files, mentions) in the sidebar editor instead of the system default app
betterSidebar.settingsOpenPathTitle: Open chat files in the sidebar
betterSidebar.settingsOpenTitle: Open by default for new conversations
betterSidebar.settingsSchemeAutoDesc: Conservative: only the standard Window Controls Overlay API contributes (real caption-overlay height); plain web environments get no modification
betterSidebar.settingsSchemeCustomDesc: Full control: inject custom CSS (can override built-in styles) and set the title-bar shift distance
betterSidebar.settingsSchemeWebDesc: Explicitly declare the official web UI: no adaptation at all (not even standard WCO geometry)
betterSidebar.settingsShellArgsDesc: Explicit shell arguments, space-separated; when non-empty they fully replace the defaults (same contract as the yaml shellArgs)
betterSidebar.settingsShellDesc: Shell spawned for UI and model terminals (absolute path or bare executable). Empty keeps the legacy order: yaml config.shell → $SHELL / login shell / Windows powershell.exe. Applies to terminals opened afterwards
betterSidebar.settingsSubagentDesc: Expand the side card and open the Tasks page when the current conversation spawns a new subagent; turn off to open it manually
betterSidebar.settingsSubagentTitle: Auto-open the Tasks page when a subagent appears
betterSidebar.settingsTitleBarDesc: Pick the title-bar compatibility scheme: auto-detect (default, conservative) / DSH official web / known desktop shells / custom (shift distance + custom CSS)
betterSidebar.settingsTitleBarStripDesc: Title-bar strip height: how far the sidebar buttons and content move down in px (0–120, default 40; applies under the custom scheme)
betterSidebar.settingsToolsDesc: When enabled, the model can create and drive sidebar terminals through the 8 terminal_* tools (off by default)
betterSidebar.settingsToolsTitle: Inject terminal tools for the model
betterSidebar.settingsWidthDesc: The side card's default share of the window width for new conversations (20–60)
betterSidebar.sideChatCancelTitle: Abort the running turn (queued work is kept)
betterSidebar.sideChatCloseTitle: Release the thread's agent (history is kept)
betterSidebar.sideChatEmptyDesc: Every side conversation is its own tab in the tab strip — it inherits the current session's context and never enters the main conversation
betterSidebar.sideChatFirstPlaceholder: Ask the first question — context inherited…
betterSidebar.sideChatNoTurn: Save is available after the first completed turn
betterSidebar.sideChatPendingDrop: The last unanswered follow-up will not be included in the saved session
betterSidebar.sideChatSaveTitle: Promote this thread to a top-level session in the main session list
betterSidebar.subagentEmptyDesc: Subagents spawned under the main agent will appear here
betterSidebar.terminalDepsFailed: Terminal dependency node-pty failed to load
betterSidebar.terminalDepsHint: Run the command below in a terminal or cmd on the DSH machine to repair it, then retry (node-pty stays in sync with the DSH core version):
betterSidebar.truncation: File too large — showing the first 512KB
betterSidebar.uploadDropChat: Drop onto the chat to add images
betterSidebar.uploadTooLarge: File too large (over the upload limit)

dsh-gitea.description: Gitea or Forgejo tools and credentials.
dsh-gitea.intro: Create a DSH credential, paste the API token there, then type only the credential name below (for example GITEA_TOKEN). Never paste the token into this form.
dsh-gitea.title: Gitea
dsh-gitea.tokenEnvHint: Name of the DSH credential, not the token itself. Default GITEA_TOKEN.

dsh-image-gen.f.apiKeyEnvHint: Credential reference / env var holding the FAL API key. The "Key " auth prefix is added automatically.
dsh-image-gen.f.customBaseURLHint: API root without a trailing slash. The request goes to {base}/images/generations.
dsh-image-gen.f.customKeyEnvHint: Credential reference / env var with the API key. Empty means no authorization header, for gateways that need none.
dsh-image-gen.f.customModelHint: Model id sent to that API, e.g. gpt-image-1.
dsh-image-gen.f.customSizeHint: Leave empty and the named size is translated automatically (square_hd → 1024x1024). Set it only for an API picky about sizes.
dsh-image-gen.f.defaultFormatHint: Used when the tool call omits output_format.
dsh-image-gen.f.defaultSizeHint: Used when the tool call omits image_size.
dsh-image-gen.f.deliverAs: How the image reaches the chat
dsh-image-gen.f.deliverAsHint: link — the result is text with a link and the card renders the picture from it; works with any chat model. image — the result carries the picture itself, which a text-only chat model cannot read, so this needs dsh-vision-bridge or a vision-capable model.
dsh-image-gen.f.modelHint: FAL model id, called as {baseURL}/{model}. Used when provider is fal.
dsh-image-gen.f.outputDirHint: Relative to the session working directory; an absolute path is used as given.
dsh-image-gen.f.pollIntervalMsHint: Status polling interval while a job runs.
dsh-image-gen.f.providerHint: fal — the FAL queue configured below. custom — any OpenAI-compatible API, configured further down.
dsh-image-gen.f.timeoutMsHint: Total generation timeout: submit + poll + download.
dsh-image-gen.settings.credentialHint: API keys live in Credentials under the references set below (Settings → Credentials).
dsh-image-gen.settings.description: generate_image tool. Provider: the FAL queue, or any OpenAI-compatible images API.
dsh-image-gen.settings.readOnly: This deployment is read-only: settings cannot be changed from the GUI.
dsh-image-gen.settings.title: Image generation
dsh-image-gen.settings.unavailable: The harness has not published this plugin’s settings yet. If it has just restarted, the section appears on its own in a few seconds.

dsh-key-rotation.cardDesc: Per-provider API key rotation: pools of keys, automatic failover on quota/rate-limit errors, cooldown and recovery.
dsh-key-rotation.desc: Per-provider API key rotation. For each provider, list its API keys (env names, stored in DSH credentials). The plugin routes a model through that provider’s keys in order and switches to the next on a quota/rate-limit failure.
dsh-key-rotation.keyHint: The value is stored in DSH credentials and never sent back to the browser — only its last 5 characters are shown. Names are generated for you; hover a key to see the one it uses.
dsh-key-rotation.noProviders: No providers registered with DSH — nothing to pick from yet.
dsh-key-rotation.subtitle: Per-provider API key rotation: pools of keys, automatic failover on quota/rate-limit errors, cooldown and recovery.
dsh-key-rotation.title: Key Rotation

dsh-market.agentBusyInstall: An agent is currently working — wait for it to finish (or cancel it) before installing. Installing changes plugin files, so a working agent can fail mid-turn.
dsh-market.agentBusyUpdate: An agent is currently working — wait for it to finish (or cancel it) before updating. Updates replace plugin files in place, so a working agent can fail or mix versions mid-turn.
dsh-market.aiFixConservative: Be conservative: only fix the clear errors listed above (boot failures / duplicate entries / confirmed dependency mismatches). Treat warnings and informational entries (e.g. unconfirmed peer ranges) only when they relate to a clear error. Do not perform unnecessary upgrades or reordering; explain each change and wait for confirmation.
dsh-market.aiFixCopied: Fix prompt copied — paste it into a new conversation and send when ready
dsh-market.aiFixFail: Clipboard unavailable — copy the diagnostics below manually
dsh-market.aiFixHint: Hand the diagnostics to a new Agent session (copied to the clipboard; you decide whether to send)
dsh-market.aiFixIntro: Please help me fix the plugin issues of DeepSeek Harness (profile: {0}). Diagnostics found:
dsh-market.aiFixScope: You may reorder dsh.profile.bundles, disable/enable plugins, or adjust cordis.patch.yml. Note: official bundles are fixed; state your plan before changing anything.
dsh-market.autoBackup: Back up daily (when the market opens)
dsh-market.backupHint: Includes the plugin list and profile configuration, never node_modules. Restore reinstalls plugins from the list.
dsh-market.brokenBundleBanner: These plugins now have a client bundle that will not parse; the page may come up blank after a refresh — rolling back is recommended:
dsh-market.buildsSkipped: This plugin needs its build scripts to run; they are blocked by default for safety. Click below to allow them and reinstall:
dsh-market.busyWait: Another operation is already running — please wait for it to finish (one install/update/uninstall at a time)
dsh-market.checkOrderTip: community bundle load order conflicts with declared before/after rules
dsh-market.compatRiskBanner: Compatibility risk detected — open Diagnostics before restarting, or roll this operation back.
dsh-market.confirmWarn: Plugins are third-party community code. Installing means you trust this source; build scripts are blocked by default.
dsh-market.conflictBody: It conflicts with an installed plugin — only one can stay:
dsh-market.conflictDeclined: You kept the installed plugins; this one was not installed
dsh-market.conflictReplaceFailed: Replace did not finish. The plugins below were uninstalled and not restored — please check them:
dsh-market.conflictSwapNote: Settings of the uninstalled plugins are kept, so you can reinstall later
dsh-market.conflictTitle: Cannot install: conflicts with an installed plugin
dsh-market.conflictWhy: cordis refuses a plugin tree that contains duplicate entry ids; keeping this plugin would stop DeepSeek Harness from starting.
dsh-market.credsWarning: Heads up: backups include profile configuration and files that may hold secrets (config.toml, .env, …). Local exports are unmodified, so only upload to a WebDAV target you trust.
dsh-market.deprecatedWarn: This plugin is marked as deprecated by the catalog; new users are advised against installing it.
dsh-market.diagExplainText: This page checks for plugins that conflict with each other, mismatched dependencies, or wrong load order. Terms used:
dsh-market.diagOkAll: All good: no conflict, dependency or ordering issues found
dsh-market.diagTermBundle: bundle = one plugin package, applied in order
dsh-market.diagTermEntry: entry = one item a plugin registers in the running composition
dsh-market.diagTermOrder: load order = the order plugins activate; the later one may override the earlier
dsh-market.diagTermOrphan: invalid entry = config references something that does not exist
dsh-market.diagTermPeer: peer dependency = another package a plugin requires from the host
dsh-market.diagTermShadow: shadowing = a plugin’s old copy covers the host’s newer one
dsh-market.duplicateNames: Same-name plugins (informational only, not a conflict)
dsh-market.envFixFail: Automatic setup failed — export the log and attach it to your issue
dsh-market.envMissing: pnpm needs to be set up before installing plugins
dsh-market.exportedLog: Log exported: dsh-market-log.txt — please attach it to your issue
dsh-market.gistErrAuth: GitHub authentication failed: invalid/expired token, or gh CLI not logged in
dsh-market.gistErrInvalid: Gist content is invalid or uses an unsupported backup format
dsh-market.gistErrNetwork: Cannot reach GitHub — check your network or proxy
dsh-market.gistErrNoId: Update mode needs a Gist ID — fill it in, or switch to “Create”
dsh-market.gistErrNotFound: Gist not found — check the ID or URL
dsh-market.gistErrRateLimit: GitHub rate limit hit, or the token lacks the gist scope
dsh-market.gistErrTimeout: GitHub request timed out — check your network and retry
dsh-market.gistExportHint: All checked = full backup (config included); unchecking any exports only the selected plugins, with an optional “include config” flag.
dsh-market.gistId: Gist ID or URL (leave empty on export to create a new private Gist)
dsh-market.gistModeUpdate: Update the Gist in the field
dsh-market.gistNoPlugins: This profile has no plugins to export
dsh-market.gistNote: Unlike local export (this-machine archive), Gist is for cross-machine sync: export to a private Gist, then import it on another computer with the same account to reuse your plugins. The token lives in this session's memory only and is never written to browser storage; a logged-in gh CLI or DSH_GITHUB_TOKEN skips entering it. Gists are private, 1 MB per file.
dsh-market.gistToken: GitHub token (session memory only — re-enter after refresh; leave empty to use server-side DSH_GITHUB_TOKEN or a logged-in gh CLI)
dsh-market.groupAddEmpty: Every installed plugin is already in this group
dsh-market.hostDependencyWarning: A plugin lists known shared DSH host packages in dependencies. This may shadow the host version; the check is manifest-only and does not confirm a duplicate runtime instance:
dsh-market.installedEmpty: No community plugins yet — browse the Discover tab
dsh-market.loadFail: Failed to load the plugin catalog, please retry later
dsh-market.localOnly: The WebDAV URL and credentials stay in this browser only.
dsh-market.opDoneRefresh: Installed · refresh the page to apply
dsh-market.opEmptyHint: Install, update and uninstall progress appears here
dsh-market.opLeaveHint: You can leave this page; you will be notified when it finishes
dsh-market.opNeedsChoice: Cannot install · reverted automatically, nothing changed
dsh-market.orderAlreadyOptimal: Current order already satisfies every rule and plugin dependency — nothing to reorder
dsh-market.orderConflicts: before/after conflicts in the current order
dsh-market.orderDiffHint: This order would change the composition: {0} override(s), {1} orphan(s), {2} duplicate(s)
dsh-market.orderDragHint: Drag ⠿ to reorder; clicking "Apply order" saves it
dsh-market.progressHint: First installs download and resolve dependencies — large plugins can take 1-3 minutes
dsh-market.refreshBanner: change(s) applied — refresh the page to see them
dsh-market.restartBanner: change(s) done — restart DeepSeek Harness to apply

Use systemctl restart <your unit>. If your unit can survive a self-restart (KillMode=process), turn Allow restart on in this plugin's configuration.

dsh-market.restoreConfirm: Restore will overwrite this profile configuration and reinstall plugins. Continue?
dsh-market.restoreMissing: {0} plugins from this backup are not installed

dsh-market.setChannelDevHint: Unverified builds from a development branch. Not recommended for general use.

settings.commandcode.accountKeyHint: This account’s API key. Saving with the field blank keeps the stored key.

settings.commandcode.apiBaseHint: Defaults to https://api.commandcode.ai; usually leave as-is.

settings.commandcode.loginFailedGeneric: Sign-in failed; try again or paste the key manually.

settings.commandcode.loginNetwork: Could not reach the Command Code service to validate the key; check your network and retry.
settings.commandcode.loginStoreFailed: The key could not be stored in the local credential service; paste it manually.

settings.commandcode.loginUnavailable: Sign-in is unavailable in this environment; paste the API key instead.
settings.commandcode.loginWaiting: Waiting for authorization in your browser…
settings.commandcode.requestTimeoutMsHint: Time to wait for the first response byte; default 60000.

settings.commandcode.updateHint: A newer version has been published; click for release notes. The notice disappears once the plugin is updated.
